values.note: Parking spurs 16-30 ft, so only some sites take a 23-ft rig. Two tents and two vehicles, or one RV, per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/hall-valley-campground ('nine campsites at an elevation of 9,900 feet with parking spur lengths of 16-30 feet'; 'two tents and two vehicles or one recreation vehicle is allowed'), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/hall-valley-campground ('Vault toilet'; 'Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Full service Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend; an extended season follows when water, trash or a host may not be available. All dates weather dependent.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/hall-valley-campground ('Seasons of Use: Year-round'; 'Visitors may expect full service from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend. The area also has an extended season when services such as water, trash or a host may not be available during the fall/winter/spring'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Strictly first-come. Pay cash, check or money order on site, or by recreation.gov Scan and Pay.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/hall-valley-campground ('This is strictly a first-come, first-serve site'; 'Scan and pay is available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165340 ('available on a first-come, first-served basis only'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $24 a site (two vehicles or one RV); $11 a third vehicle. Senior/Access passes halve the site fee.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/hall-valley-campground ('$24 fee per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles or one RV per site is included in the camping fee. $11 for a third vehicle.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165340/rates (2026 First-come season 2026-05-22 to 09-19: 24), read 2026-10-28

note: Small Forest Service campground at 9,900 ft off Park County Road 60, north of US-285 at Webster toward Red Cone and Webster passes (four-wheel-drive routes beyond the campground). Only the longer parking spurs fit a 23-ft rig. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov Scan and Pay listing: confirmed 9 sites, spurs 16-30 ft (max 30 is the agency figure), vault toilet, no potable water, $24. Changed booking from inherited reservable to first-come only; season year-round (FS) with full service Memorial Day - Labor Day. Note trimmed.
flags: Missing phone: South Platte Ranger District 303-275-5610 (FS page, 'Office Contact Information'). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's line (303) 647-2366.
